### Overview
This diff represents a modification to the `src/app/diffExcerpt.ts` file between the `NovaDiff-main` and `NovaDiff` branches. The change involves modifying the `buildDiffExcerptChunks` function to improve the performance of the diff excerpts generation process.

### Key changes
The following are the most important implementation changes made in this diff:

* Added a new constant `FILE_SUMMARY_MAX_CHUNKS` to control the maximum number of chunks generated by the `buildDiffExcerptChunks` function.
* Modified the `buildDiffExcerptChunks` function to use the `FILE_SUMMARY_MAX_CHUNKS` constant to determine the maximum number of chunks to generate.
* Added a new exported function `buildDiffExcerpt` that generates a single excerpt for the entire diff, rather than multiple chunks.

### Impact
This change is expected to improve the performance of the diff excerpts generation process by reducing the number of chunks generated and improving the efficiency of the `buildDiffExcerptChunks` function.
